labels.name: Stratum corneum
labels.function: Only layer Malassezia reaches; few or no symptoms

labels.name: Epidermis
labels.function: Inner layers penetrated by keratin-loving dermatophytes

labels.name: Dermis
labels.function: Also reached by dermatophytes and by disseminated systemic fungi

labels.name: Subcutaneous tissue
labels.function: Deepest layer, infected only in deep fungal disease (biopsy)

labels.name: Hair shaft
labels.function: Spores within it in T. tonsurans scalp infection (no glow)

labels.name: Hair follicle
labels.function: Infection here needs oral therapy; topicals recur

labels.name: Round yeast form
labels.function: The "meatballs" of Malassezia in pityriasis versicolor

labels.name: Short hyphal form
labels.function: The "spaghetti" strands of pityriasis versicolor

labels.name: Branching septate hypha
labels.function: Dermatophyte filament seen on KOH prep in tinea

labels.name: Septum
labels.function: Cross-wall that divides a dermatophyte filament into cells

labels.name: Pseudohypha
labels.function: Elongated cells in one filament, constricted where cells join

labels.name: Blastospore
labels.function: Small budding structure attached to Candida filaments

labels.name: Endothrix spores
labels.function: Inside the shaft (T. tonsurans); no Wood's lamp glow

labels.name: Ectothrix spores
labels.function: Coat the outside (M. canis); fluoresce under Wood's lamp

labels.name: Tinea capitis
labels.function: Children; T. tonsurans most common; oral therapy 4-8 weeks

labels.name: Tinea faciei
labels.function: Non-beard face, often ages 20-40; oral therapy

labels.name: Tinea barbae
labels.function: Relatively rare; older teen and adult males; oral therapy

labels.name: Tinea corporis
labels.function: Trunk or limbs ring with central clearing; topical 2-4 wks

labels.name: Tinea manuum
labels.function: Often one palm, paired with both feet in a classic pattern

labels.name: Tinea cruris
labels.function: Advancing border from the groin; scrotum spared

labels.name: Tinea pedis
labels.function: Interdigital or moccasin type; often spreads to the groin

labels.name: Tinea unguium
labels.function: Nail plate; oral 6 wks fingernails, 12+ wks toenails
